boundary_vocabulary.DISCOVERABLE: An index or catalog can name the item; discovery does not authorize use.
boundary_vocabulary.REGISTERED: An operation id is present in the operation registry; registration does not prove implementation or execution.
boundary_vocabulary.METADATA_LOADABLE: Pack Registry validates/loads declarative metadata only; it does not import or execute hooks.
boundary_vocabulary.ROUTED_PROPOSAL: Pack-aware routing emits a proposal; no domain action is performed by the router.
boundary_vocabulary.EXECUTABLE_UNDER_DECLARED_RUNTIME: Use only when an exact implementation entrypoint, executor binding, and declared execution conditions are evidenced; no operation is assigned this state by this map.
boundary_vocabulary.EXPERIMENTAL_OPT_IN: An optional catalog entry remains Experimental and default-off; use requires a separate explicit selection under its declared contract.
boundary_vocabulary.DEFERRED: The registry contract is status-only, deferred, historical, or unsupported for execution routing.
boundary_vocabulary.UNRESOLVED: An exact implementation/executor mapping is not established by the cited authority assets.
